name: Quarrels
overview: Scripture reveals that quarrels are often fueled by anger and foolishness, as a wrathful person stirs up strife while one who is slow to anger seeks to calm it. The beginning of contention is likened to letting out water, urging believers to avoid escalating disputes before they grow. Engaging in quarrels without cause is compared to grabbing a dog by the ears—dangerous and unwise—while contentious individuals act like burning coals that ignite further conflict. True honor lies in ceasing from strife rather than meddling in it, highlighting the wisdom of pursuing peace over discord.
